title: Rain-Barrel Refill and Irrigation Reserve
dataSources: Beehive weight and entrance activity (`beehive:weight`), hive climate (`beehive:climate`), brooder climate (`brooder:climate`), egg counts (`coop:egg`), rain-barrel level (`rainbarrel:level`), greenhouse climate (`greenhouse:climate`), orchard bloom observations (`orchard:bloom`), and milking logs (`milking:session`).
app: Homestead telemetry from beehive monitors, coop sensors, brooder controls, greenhouse sensors, rain barrels, orchard logs, and milking records streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, LoRaWAN, and Home Assistant.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rainbarrel:level
| timechart span=6h latest(level_pct) as level_pct avg(outflow_lpm) as outflow_lpm
description: Shows refill cycles and drawdown on rain barrels so you can judge irrigation reserve before dry spells.
value: Rainwater storage is most useful when you understand how quickly it refills and empties under real garden use.
implementation: Monitor rain-barrel level and irrigation outflow with a level sensor and a simple flow meter.
visualization: Dual-axis line chart of barrel level percent and outflow rate.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks how full your rain barrels are and how fast you are using that water for the garden.
